title.narrative: Energy and Environment Partnership Africa Trust Fund (EEP Africa)

description.narrative: The Energy and Environment Partnership Africa Trust Fund (EEP Africa) is a multi-donor fund hosted and managed by the Nordic Development Fund (NDF). Its overall objective is to enhance clean energy access, development and investment, with a focus on benefiting poor and underserved households and communities. EEP Africa invests in companies that are piloting or scaling clean energy technologies and business models primarily targeting poor communities in Africa. This is done by providing early stage financing and technical assistance to build sustainable businesses. The Danish contribution will support the work of EEP Africa and contribute to consolidating the fund as a catalytic financing facility.
